# New sidequest "Costa's Affairs" / "Costa Business"

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_171_nukaknights-post-sidequest-costa-business.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

On June 20, 2023, a new side quest awaits you in Patch 44 "When the Stars Are Favorable" update: "**Costa's Affairs**"

The sidequest takes place at the **Blue Ridge Caravan Company** and directly involves 8 employees. The catch is that the side quest cannot be played in one session, but can be completed in 8 days like a daily task. The side quest "Costa's Affairs" is therefore not a permanent new daily quest. The 8 quests can only be played once per character, every 20 hours. In principle, it's more of a divided side quest than permanent new daily tasks.

The side quest "Costa's Affairs" is about the fact that things are not going well at the Blue Ridge Caravan Company at the moment and Vinny Costa asks us to ask around and help the individual employees.

## Requirements

In order to be able to play every 8 days, your character must meet a few requirements:

- You need a **camera**. See also: Camera: This is the fastest way to get the ProSnap Deluxe camera
- Completion of the **Quest "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing"** (Van Lowe Quest Series)
- **Quest "Out of the Blue"** (Steel Reign quest series)
- This means: Both the **Steel Dawn questline** and the **Steel Reign questline** must be completed.

Unless you meet all of these requirements, you can only complete some of the tasks.

## This is how you start the side quest “Costa’s Affairs”

Most of you know the **Big Bend Tunnel East Entrance**. The “Co-driver” event also starts at this location. As with the co-driver event, go to the podium on the right and talk to Vinny Costa.
